An Economist/YouGov poll conducted August 28 to 31 found 58 percent opposed raising tariffs on Canadian goods, 68 percent said Trump’s tariffs had hurt average Americans, and 64 percent viewed Canada as an ally or friendly.

A CBS News/YouGov poll, conducted September 8 to 11 among 2,460 U.S. adults, found 58 percent of likely voters considered tariffs very important, 56 percent preferred a candidate opposed to Trump’s approach, and 45 percent saw their vote as opposition to him.
